address: 43-45F, Forty-Five, Gloucester Tower, Landmark, 15 Queen's Road Central, Central, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: The top three floors of a prestigious office tower in Central have been remodelled into a swanky restaurant with drop-dead harbour views. Green velvet is a prominent feature, with contrasting splashes of orange on the semi-circular banquettes. Well-crafted traditional Shanghainese and Jiangzhe classics like braised wheat gluten, sautéed “dragon beard” shredded mandarin fish, and osmanthus honey glazed Jinhua ham. Ask for dishes that need pre-ordering....
